{{EpicodePrevNext| prevcode=PT18 | prevtitle=Bonding with Kangaskhan | nextcode=PT20 | nexttitle= | series=POKÉTOON | colorscheme=Z-A}} {{EpisodeInfobox| epcode=PT19 | colorscheme=Z-A | title_en=Another Day with Gardevoir | title_ja=明日もサーナイトと | title_ja_trans=Tomorrow with Sirnight | release_method=Web release | screen=hd | broadcast_jp=October 24, 2025 | broadcast_us=December 19, 2025 | en_op=None | en_ed=None | ja_op=None | ja_ed=None | olmteam=100Studio | scenario= | storyboard= | director= | art=荒木裕 | morecredits=no | epstaffpage=PT18-PT20 | footnotes=* {{BMGf|308810|Review thread on BMGf}} * [https://youtu.be/1JtuxmEiYl4 【公式】ポケモンアニメ 「明日もサーナイトと」 【POKÉTOON】] on the official Japanese [[YouTube]] channel * [https://youtu.be/3vDXiMLRm7E Another Day with Gardevoir ✨ | POKÉTOON Shorts] on the official English YouTube channel }} '''Another Day with Gardevoir''' (Japanese: '''明日もサーナイトと''' ''Tomorrow with {{tt|Sirnight|Gardevoir}}'') is the second episode of the third season of [[POKÉTOON]] and nineteenth overall. It was first released in Japan on the official Japanese Pokémon [[YouTube]] channel on October 24, 2025 and on the official English and Western Pokémon [[YouTube]] channels on December 19, 2025. ==Blurb== ''Yugo dreams of the time he spent training to be a champion with Gardevoir, his partner Pokémon, but now he’s too tired and busy with work. However, some friendships and dreams are just too mega to be forgotten... ✨'' ==Plot== In a battle stadium packed by spectators, two Trainers stand on opposite side. One sent out her [[Mawile]], while Yugo sent out his [[Gardevoir]]. Unexpectedly, he wakes up and finds that it was nothing more than a dream of the past. He finds himself late to work as a delivery man, and quickly leaves saying goodbye to his Gardevoir. While at his truck, Yugo removes Qualot Berry toy from his bag and hangs it in the car. As he goes through his delivery, his Gardevoir hides behind the truck watching him in secret. As he made another delivery in a house where a boy and his [[Emolga]] excitedly ran over to the box he brought, he is reminded of the time he was a young boy who got injured and was healed by a wild [[Ralts]]. Feeling Pokémon then gave a [[Qualot Berry]] to him. The same Ralts then became his partner evolving to Kirlia and then Gardevoir. He is then brought back and wryly smiles at the memory when the box he delivered happen to contain the same Berry. Yugo comes back home tired and falls asleep as his Gardevoir watches over him remembering Yugo finding [[Gardevoirite]] and immediately hooking [[Mega Stone]] to the Gardevoir's hair. It's next flashback starts when Yugo's earlier dream had, but continues into them losing the battle, and Yugo walking discouragedly away. Gardevoir comes to her senses when Yugo apologies for that through his sleep, and Embrace Pokémon knows this loss still haunts it's Trainer. The next day it is dark and rainy outside, and Yugo, being distracted by another flashback (in which he puts his keystone into his desk inside his parents' house and calls Gardevoir into the next journey), narrowly misses a [[Skiddo]] and a [[Gogoat]] on the curvy mountain road but crashes a little into the cliff. Suddenly this cliff suffers from a landslide, and Yugo tries to stop the truck from falling. Gardevoir reveals itself and tries to help him but they are both pushed off the cliff. Yugo grabs Qualot Berry toy and then Gardevoir just in time and his hidden keystone shines along with the Gardevoirite causing Gardevoir to Mega Evolve into Mega Gardevoir. With it's power they were able to eliminate the landslide with a single [[Moonblast]]. Yugo and his partner gave a five to each other which causes Qualot Berry toy to smash. Yugo then discovers his keystone was hidden inside of it, and, having realised his partner did it, tells Gardevoir it's the greatest partner to which it responded enthusiastically. Short ends with them driving, this time with Gardevoir in the passenger seat, in the clear sun happily. ==Characters== ===Humans=== * [[Yugo]] * Woman * Old man * Mother * Little boy * {{pkmn|Trainer}} (flashback) * Stadium audience (flashback) ** {{tc|Hex Maniac}} ** {{tc|Pokémon Breeder}} ** {{tc|Tourist}} ** {{tc|Hiker}} ** {{tc|Psychic}} ** {{tc|Schoolgirl}} ** {{tc|Schoolboy}} ** {{tc|Fairy Tale Girl}} ** {{tc|Rising Star}} ** {{tc|Lass}} * Announcer (flashback;
